name: unistyles-codemod
description: One-shot styled-components -> react-native-unistyles@3 transform for apps/mobile. Not part of the pnpm workspace on purpose: it installs its own node_modules with npm so it can never perturb the app's lockfile. styled-components is a dependency HERE rather than in the app because the parity ledger still replays its pipeline to compute ground truth, and the app itself no longer ships it.

scripts.test: tsx test/run.ts && tsx src/parity.ts && tsx src/parity-manual.ts
